quests.instruction: Touch the body part where you buckle your belt around your trousers!
quests.hint: Your belt goes around this part!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Waist is the middle part of your body, between your chest and your hips!
quests.funFact: Did you know? bending at the waist allows you to touch your toes.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that makes up your leg between your hip and your knee!
quests.hint: They are the top part of your legs!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Thighs are the top part of your leg, between your hip and your knee!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the femur bone inside your thigh is the body's longest bone.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that swings side to side when you dance!
quests.hint: Your legs connect to your body right here!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Hips are where your legs connect to your body, and help your legs swing!
quests.funFact: Did you know? they bear the weight of your upper body when you stand.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a hard, smooth tip at the end of each toe!
quests.hint: They are hard and grow at your toe tips!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Toenails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each toe and protects it!
quests.funFact: Did you know? they grow much slower than your fingernails.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that moves up and down when you chew your food!
quests.hint: It moves up and down when you chew!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Jaw moves up and down to help you chew and talk!
quests.funFact: Did you know? it is the only bone in your skull that can move.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a hard, smooth tip at the end of each finger!
quests.hint: They are hard and grow at your fingertips!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Fingernails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each finger and protects it!
quests.funFact: Did you know? they grow about three to four times faster than toenails.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that covers your whole body, from head to toe!
quests.hint: It covers every single part of your body!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Skin covers your whole body and helps you feel hot, cold, soft, and rough!
quests.funFact: Did you know? it constantly renews itself, shedding dead cells and growing new ones.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms the bottom of your foot and touches the ground first!
quests.hint: They are the bottom part of your feet!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Soles are the bottom of your feet that touch the ground!
quests.funFact: Did you know? they have hundreds of thousands of sweat glands.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms the back of your leg, between your knee and your ankle!
quests.hint: They are the back of your lower legs!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Calves are the back of your lower leg, between your knee and your ankle!
quests.funFact: Did you know? they give you the power to stand on your tiptoes.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that rumbles loudly when you are hungry!
quests.hint: It rumbles when you are hungry!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Tummy is the middle of your body that helps digest the food you eat!
quests.funFact: Did you know? strong stomach acid breaks down food into nutrients.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that faces up when someone gives you a high five!
quests.hint: They are the flat, inside part of your hands!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Palms are the flat, soft inside part of your hands!
quests.funFact: Did you know? they have complex creases that develop before you are even born.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms the round back part of your foot!
quests.hint: They are the round back part of your feet!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Heels are the round back part of your feet that touch the ground first!
quests.funFact: Did you know? it strikes the ground first when you are walking normally.

quests.instruction: Find the body part we use to run fast in the park and touch it!
quests.hint: Think about this: Your feet are found at the end of these.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Legs help you walk, run, and jump!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: the femur bone in your thigh is stronger than concrete.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part we count on when we learn numbers!
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are found at the end of your hands.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Fingers help you point, count, and pick up small things!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your fingers help you feel the texture of objects.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that grows on top of your head and touch it!
quests.hint: Think about this: It grows longer if you do not cut it.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Hair grows on top of your head and helps keep it warm!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: hair grows slightly faster in warmer weather.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part we use to wave hello and goodbye!
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wave these to say goodbye.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Arms help you hug, wave, and carry things!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: you can bend your arms thanks to your elbow joint.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part we use to listen to happy music!
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Your favorite song plays through these.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Ears help you hear sounds like music and voices!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: the smallest bone in your entire body is inside your ear.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part that holds up the straps of your backpack!
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You lift these up when you shrug.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Shoulders are where your arms connect to your body, and help you shrug and lift!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: the shoulder joint is called a ball-and-socket joint.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part you look at in the mirror every morning!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You see this when you look in a mirror!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Face is the front of your head, with your eyes, nose, and mouth!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your face contains over 40 different muscles.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part that pushes up high on your face when you smile!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have two, one on each side of your face!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Cheeks are the soft round parts on the sides of your face!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your cheeks help you chew by keeping food inside your mouth.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part that helps you taste if food is sweet or sour!
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You stick this out to taste snowflakes.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Tongue helps you taste your food and speak clearly!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: just like fingerprints, everyone has a unique tongue print.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part where your legs connect to the rest of your body?
quests.hint: They are below your waist.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Hips are where your legs connect to your body, and help your legs swing!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the hip is a very stable ball-and-socket joint.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that helps you push hard when you pedal a bike?
quests.hint: They are between your hip and your knee.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Thighs are the top part of your leg, between your hip and your knee!
quests.funFact: Did you know? thigh muscles provide the main power for kicking a ball.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that bends when you touch your toes?
quests.hint: It is between your chest and your hips.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Waist is the middle part of your body, between your chest and your hips!
quests.funFact: Did you know? core muscles around your waist help you maintain good balance.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that grows slowly, a little bit every month?
quests.hint: You trim these to keep them short too.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Toenails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each toe and protects it!
quests.funFact: Did you know? toenails are made of a tough protein called keratin.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that grows a little longer every single week?
quests.hint: You trim these to keep them short.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Fingernails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each finger and protects it!
quests.funFact: Did you know? like hair, fingernails are made completely of dead cells.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part found below your cheeks, holding your bottom teeth?
quests.hint: Your bottom teeth are held inside it.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Jaw moves up and down to help you chew and talk!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the jaw allows you to chew tough food and speak clearly.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that feels warm sand at the beach?
quests.hint: They touch the inside of your shoes.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Soles are the bottom of your feet that touch the ground!
quests.funFact: Did you know? soles act as natural shock absorbers when walking barefoot.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part you smack together after a tasty, sweet treat!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They curve up when you smile!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Lips are the soft edges around your mouth that help you smile and talk!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your lips are incredibly sensitive and have millions of nerve endings.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part found halfway between your shoulder and your wrist!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are the bendy part in the middle of your arm!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Elbows are the bendy joints in the middle of your arms!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your elbow is a hinge joint that lets you bend your arm.
